name: SITELINE
tagline: Round-based tactical FPS at a desert relay station

teams.attack: Sappers: plant the charge at SITE A inside the relay hall
teams.defend: Custodians: hold the hall, defuse the charge, or run the clock out

controls.LMB: fire (automatic for rifle/SMG, single shot for the DMR)
controls.F: hold to defuse with a kit
controls.1-6: quick buy while the buy phase runs

systems.simulation: Fixed 120 Hz step (sim.js + movement.js + bots.js) fully separated from rendering (main.js). Rendering reads state, never mutates it.
systems.combat: Hitscan traces against head/torso/leg boxes with a 4x head multiplier and 0.75x legs; armour halves body damage. Spread grows with speed, recoil and airtime, so stopping to aim pays.
systems.weapons: VARL-7 rifle (27 dmg, 600 rpm), Kestrel 9 SMG (18 dmg, 900 rpm), Warden 62 DMR (62 dmg, 200 rpm), frag charge, armour, defuse kit.
systems.economy: Start with $800; round win $3250, loss $1400, kill $300. Purchases only in the buy phase.
systems.objective: Charge plants in 3.2 s on site, 40 s fuse, 5 s defuse. Rounds end by detonation, defuse, elimination or timeout, then restart after 5 s.
systems.bots: Nav-graph A* with visibility-checked edges, throttled perception (~90 ms), reaction delay, noise investigation for gunfire and explosions, cover-seeking reloads and stuck re-pathing.
systems.map: Compact relay station: west arcade and east freight lane, splitter block, hall with two doors, crates and cargo cover, painted site decal and signage.
systems.presentation: Dusk palette (sand, teal, ember), procedural canvas textures, gradient sky dome, practical lamps, first-person viewmodel with muzzle flash and recoil.

files.game/main.js: renderer, input, 120 Hz accumulator, debug hooks
files.game/sim.js: fixed-step phase clock, planting/defusing, grenades, win conditions
files.game/combat.js: weapons, hit traces, damage, noise events
files.game/bots.js: bot perception, A* routes, hold/investigate/cover states
files.game/map.js: map layout, collision solids, ray tests
files.game/hud.js: DOM HUD, buy menu wiring, kill feed
files.game/state.js: single state object, constants, round lifecycle
files.game/index.html: import map for three 0.187.0, HUD markup and styling

debugHooks.purpose: test scaffolding used by tests/browser.py and the screenshot capture; not gameplay cheats
debugHooks.__advance(seconds): step the fixed simulation without a browser frame
debugHooks.__tp(x,z,yaw,pitch): teleport the player for deterministic captures
debugHooks.__debug(): phase, timer, score, ammo, health, bomb and per-bot state
debugHooks.__buy(id) __fire() __reload(): drive the same code paths the input layer calls
debugHooks.__pause(flag): freeze simulation time so a frame can be captured
debugHooks.?nobots=1: spawn no bots for the objective test and buy-menu capture
